latestInject.title: Hydro Siber simulated grid-operations map
latestInject.state: Inject 8 reviewed by evidence, response and timeline
latestInject.note: 15 Drive files checked. At Dec 25, 2026 08:43 AM (dashboard label PDT), map reports 92,430 customers without power, 1,240 MW demand, 12 online / 5 degraded / 6 offline / 3 unverified feeder statuses; hospital partial with backups, water treatment offline. SUB-03 status conflicts with its own notes; SUB-07 telemetry unverified. I-001 FDR and I-008 SUB labels cannot be directly equated. Source is simulated; no cyber cause or breaker command established.

assessment.label: Situation
assessment.text: At 08:43 on Dec 25, 2026 the grid map shows 92,430 customers out and rising, the hospital on backup generators and water treatment offline. 12 of 18 feeders show no voltage or load. Cause not established. Reconciled through Inject 8 by Kevin's response chat at 13:12 PDT, pending leader review.

assessment.label: New findings
assessment.text: Password SSH from three public addresses; contractor login at midnight; su failures; adminelk sudo su to root; rsyslog stopped 44 s later. Google sign-in alert from Mount Crumpit. One managed Chrome profile downloaded a game zip and ryujinxx.exe; desktop folder holds N0Tstea1nG?CredEntials.exe. Grid map: SUB-03 'Online' at 0 MW; SUB-07 blind since 06:31.

assessment.label: Leading hypotheses
assessment.text: Working hypothesis: a game-download lure, then credential theft, contractor login, root, logging stopped, grid affected. Each step is shown; the links are not (low to moderate confidence). Approved maintenance with an unrelated failure, a monitoring fault, or unrelated downloads remain open. A cyberattack is not established.

assessment.label: Contradictions
assessment.text: I-001 footer 17/1 vs table 14/4; OFFLINE feeders with load; SUB-03 Online with a note saying offline; SUB-01 Degraded on the map, Online in the table; 8:43 labelled PST and PDT; 26 feeder statuses vs 18 feeders; 'Wed, Dec 24' vs Thursday in 2026; sudo[1802] out of order.

assessment.label: Recommended action
assessment.text: Confirm hospital generator fuel; tell the water utility and fire services the treatment plant shows offline; welfare checks; crews to SUB-03 and SUB-07. Do not switch from either screen and do not publish 92,430. Hold remote switching; image before changes; call the four account owners. Leader approves the presentation and public statement before 1:45 PM.

assessment.label: Critical unknowns
assessment.text: Breaker and relay history for 00:05:58–11:03:15 and 06:31–08:43; hospital fuel and water status on the ground; SUB-to-FDR mapping; whose computer; whether any file ran; account authorization; year and zone of I-002 and I-003; presentation length and format.
